meta.description: Registry for bounded residue-transport conservation conditions and modes in Phase 3.

residue_transport_conservation_entries.name: Residue-Transport Conservation
residue_transport_conservation_entries.purpose: Represent bounded residue persistence and conservation-sensitive transport behavior across recursive continuation structures.

residue_transport_conditions.name: bounded_residue_balance_preserved
residue_transport_conditions.description: Reduction steps must maintain residue measures within established local balance relations.

residue_transport_conditions.name: transport_flux_remains_finite
residue_transport_conditions.description: Transported continuation measure must not diverge during recursive balance calculation.

residue_transport_conditions.name: residue_transport_updates_remain_admissible
residue_transport_conditions.description: Each step in the recursive transport update must satisfy current admissibility windows.

residue_transport_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_transport_remains_bounded
residue_transport_conditions.description: Directional transport flux must stay within defined stability thresholds to preserve local balance.

residue_transport_conditions.name: residue_dissipation_detectable
residue_transport_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register residue dispersion or loss.

residue_transport_conditions.name: residue_accumulation_does_not_force_transport_divergence
residue_transport_conditions.description: Residue levels must remain below the point where transport flux becomes unstable.

residue_transport_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_residue_witness
residue_transport_conditions.description: Pruning of divergent residue states must not eliminate all admissible balance paths.

residue_transport_conditions.name: transport_does_not_force_exact_global_conservation
residue_transport_conditions.description: Local balance updates do not bypass the fundamental noninvertibility or dissipative nature of the process.
